resources.string: FITNEX AI offers general guidance and does not replace health professionals, dietitians or coaches who can assess you in person.

To answer you, FITNEX AI sends your message and only the data of the screen you open it from (for example, your stats for the month or what you ate today) to FITNEX\'s secure server, which uses Google\'s Gemini. Your name and email are not stored with the request. You can withdraw permission in Settings.
Ask me about your training, your progress or your nutrition.
Analyze my progress this month: what I\'m doing well, which muscle groups I\'m training too little and what you recommend for next week.
Which nutrients am I missing today?
Based on what I logged today, which nutrients or food groups should I add?
Give me ideas for my next workout routine based on my level.
How do I improve my technique?
Give me the key technique points and the most common mistakes for this exercise.
